headline: Jennifer Lawrence addresses returning as Mystique
post:
With the X-Men heading to the MCU, many have wondered if we might see Jennifer Lawrence play Mystique again. However, the star recently shared that she is not interested in returning to the heavy body paint and prosthetics required for the role, calling the idea an absolute no.

While she loved doing the stunts with her stunt double, dealing with the cold airbrushing and long hours in the makeup chair was too much. Since modern VFX have come a long way since her time in the Fox movies, do you think Marvel could use digital effects instead of paint? 💙

#JenniferLawrence #XMen #MCU
original_title: Jennifer Lawrence Has a Surprising Response to Returning as Mystique In a Future MCU Movie

headline: Kenner Star Wars Toy Prices Resurface
post:
Vintage Star Wars toys from the classic Kenner line carry massive price tags today compared to their original retail costs. An old catalog shared online shows how inexpensive items used to be decades ago.

Today, unsealed versions and modern releases cost significantly more, forcing many collectors out of the hobby.

#StarWars #Kenner #Collectibles
original_title: Vintage Star Wars Toy Prices Have Resurfaced and Fans Can’t Believe How Unaffordable the Hobby Is Today

headline: X-Men's Krakoa debuts with ultimate mutant powers
post:
Marvel has introduced an incredible new hero in 'Godzilla Conquers the Multiverse #4'. According to Screen Rant, Emma Frost calls in a living island named Krakoa from an alternate reality called "Universe M." In this timeline where the mutant nation never fell, the living island feeds on its residents in a controlled symbiosis.

This process has allowed Krakoa to inherit a massive range of abilities. The character proudly wields the combined powers of iconic mutants like Cyclops, Colossus, Wolverine, Jean Grey, and Magneto. It is an amazing twist for X-Men lore! 🏝️

Establishing "Universe M" gives Marvel a definitive ongoing timeline where the Krakoa Era continued without interruption. Fans can grab the new issue from Marvel Comics right now to see this epic crossover event unfold.

What other mutants do you hope to see in this alternate universe?

#XMen #MarvelComics #Krakoa
original_title: X-Men's New Hero Officially Combines Powers of Cyclops and Colossus

headline: James Gunn Reveals The Suicide Squad DCU Canon Status
post:
James Gunn has officially confirmed that The Suicide Squad is canon to the new DCU. Speaking on a podcast, the director noted that the entire movie is considered canon, despite a few minor timeline details and minor adjustments to consider.

While characters like Peacemaker and Amanda Waller are part of the DCU, questions remain regarding how certain elements like Harley Quinn's backstory and past events will fit moving forward.

headline: The Flash: New Speed Force powers
post:
Hey everyone! Comic book fans are in for a wild ride with a disturbing new development for Wally West. According to Screen Rant, writer Ryan North's run on The Flash introduces a terrifying side effect to Wally's new future-seeing ability called Flashes of Insight. 

Red Tornado reportedly reveals that overuse of the Speed Force is causing wormholes to grow inside the pain receptors of Wally's human tissue. After ignoring Green Arrow's warnings about stopping crimes before they happen, Wally has apparently been using his powers constantly. The situation escalates when the Justice League confronts him, leading to a tense standoff with his teammates.

What do you think is next for Wally West?

#TheFlash #DCComics #JusticeLeague
original_title: Flash's New Superpower Is Pure Body Horror, DC Confirms
